method: Agent read each frame directly. Bad frames viewed full size; good frames judged from a five-up sheet at 360x640, which is a harder test than full size, not an easier one.

disputedFalsePositives.note: Flagged clippedText for RECRUITER cut to 'REC' by the contact card edge. Reviewing the frame, this looks like a real defect in the shipped master rather than a critic error - the same class as 'Senior Technical Recruite'. Counted against precision anyway, because relabelling a sample to make a score look better is how a calibration stops meaning anything.

Flagged illegibleRegion for the filmstrip cards' body text. Defensible: those cards are tokens, not evidence, so unreadable body text there is intended. A future prompt revision should let the critic say 'small but not load-bearing'.
